segments.sn43.44:1.1: “Parāyanañca [parāyaṇañca (pī. sī. aṭṭha.)] vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi parāyanagāmiñca maggaṃ.
segments.sn43.44:1.4: Yo, bhikkhave, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo – idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, parāyanaṃ.
segments.sn43.44:1.9: Iti kho, bhikkhave, desitaṃ vo mayā parāyanaṃ, desito parāyanagāmimaggo.
segments.sn43.44:1.10: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
segments.sn43.44:1.11: Etāni, bhikkhave, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyatha, bhikkhave, mā pamādattha; mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī”ti.(Yathā asaṅkhataṃ tathā vitthāretabbaṃ).
segments.sn43.44:2.1: Asaṅkhataṃ anataṃ anāsavaṃ, saccañca pāraṃ nipuṇaṃ sududdasaṃ;
segments.sn43.44:2.3: Ajajjaraṃ dhuvaṃ apalokitaṃ, anidassanaṃ nippapañca santaṃ.
segments.sn43.44:3.1: Amataṃ paṇītañca sivañca khemaṃ, taṇhākkhayo acchariyañca abbhutaṃ;
segments.sn43.44:4.1: Abyāpajjho virāgo ca, suddhi mutti anālayo;
